_comment: Illustrative seed data for the free local rule engine. Keys are root domains (no 'www.', lowercase). Each entry short-circuits the keyword heuristic in local_classifier.py with a pre-vetted classification. Not exhaustive — extend as needed.

clearview.ai.explanation: This product builds a facial recognition database by scraping images from the internet without consent, which Article 5(1)(e) bans outright regardless of the product's other safeguards.
caveats: Domain matched an entry in the local rule-engine database, not a live reading of the current site content.

hirevue.com.explanation: AI-driven candidate assessment and hiring tools fall under Annex III(4) as employment/worker-management systems, requiring conformity assessment, human oversight, and registration before deployment in the EU.
caveats: Domain matched an entry in the local rule-engine database, not a live reading of the current site content.

workday.com.explanation: Workday's HR suite includes AI-assisted recruitment and worker-management features, which fall under Annex III(4) as high-risk employment systems.
caveats: Domain matched an entry in the local rule-engine database, not a live reading of the current site content.

zestfinance.com.explanation: Automated credit-underwriting models determine creditworthiness, which Annex III(5) classifies as high-risk due to its impact on access to essential financial services.
caveats: Domain matched an entry in the local rule-engine database, not a live reading of the current site content.

proctorio.com.explanation: Exam-proctoring software that monitors and flags student behaviour falls under Annex III(3) as an education/training system evaluating or monitoring test-takers.
caveats: Domain matched an entry in the local rule-engine database, not a live reading of the current site content.

openai.com.explanation: General-purpose conversational AI products carry transparency obligations to disclose that a user is interacting with AI, and to label AI-generated content. A specific deployment could shift into a higher tier depending on use case.
caveats: Domain matched an entry in the local rule-engine database, not a live reading of the current site content.
General-purpose AI providers also carry separate GPAI transparency duties under Chapter V (Articles 51-56).

intercom.com.explanation: Customer-support chatbots must disclose to users that they are interacting with an AI system per Article 50(1), unless this is already obvious from context.
caveats: Domain matched an entry in the local rule-engine database, not a live reading of the current site content.
